accepted.title: Walk With Ease
accepted.summary: <p>Walking benefits your mind, mood, and overall health. Join us for our Walk With Ease Program.</p>\n

accepted.title: Living Strong
accepted.summary: <p>Living Strong is a great way to stay active and build strength in a supportive environment. This class includes strength training, aerobic exercise, balance, flexibility and more, along with goal setting to help you stay motivated and consistent. </p>\n

accepted.title: Yoga
accepted.summary: <p>Stretch toward your fitness goals! Learn basic yoga to improve health and flexibility through deep breathing and controlled stretching. </p>\n
